goal: Restore the already-qualified official Codex launch context without mutating authentication/provider/security semantics.
compare_known_good_to_failed: absolute codex binary path and sha256
parent process provenance and effective uid/gid
HOME presence/path hash and stat metadata
CODEX_HOME presence/path hash and stat metadata
TMPDIR presence/path hash and stat metadata
cwd canonical path and stat metadata
state-db path/parent directory identity and effective access result
value_handling: For credential-bearing or potentially sensitive values record only presence + sha256. For HOME/CODEX_HOME/TMPDIR record canonical path only if already present in prior safe runtime receipts; otherwise record path hash + filesystem mode/access metadata.
repair_preference: Prefer restoring the same normal host-authorized parent execution context proven by M12DM.
Keep the official CLI child on the qualified ephemeral/read-only/no-tools boundary.
Do not chmod/chown/delete/rebuild the user's Codex auth or state database.
Do not create a custom runtime or copy credentials into a new ad-hoc home.
Do not disable sandbox/TLS/auth controls merely to launch.
systemic_startup_markers: attempt to write a readonly database
failed to initialize in-process app-server client
Operation not permitted before event stream
permission denied opening official state/auth runtime
identical pre-dispatch initialization error across batches
